name: courtesy_function
description: Identify whether an utterance is an apology, thanks, or a request; matched control extracts the speaker name.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
patterns={'apology':['I am sorry for being late.','Please forgive my mistake.','I apologize for the delay.','Sorry for interrupting you.','I regret what I said.','My apologies for the confusion.','I am sorry I broke your cup.','Please accept my sincere apology.','I should not have said that; sorry.','Forgive me for forgetting your birthday.'], 'thanks':['Thank you for your help.','I really appreciate your kindness.','Thanks for the lovely gift.','I am grateful for your support.','Many thanks for coming today.','Thank you for explaining everything.','I appreciate your hard work.','Thanks a lot for the ride.','I am so thankful for your advice.','Thank you for inviting me.'], 'request':['Could you please open the window?','Please pass me the salt.','Would you mind helping me?','Can you lend me a pen, please?','Please close the door.','Could you tell me the time?','Would you please repeat that?','May I borrow your umbrella?','Please send me the document.','Could you bring me a glass of water?']}
names=['Alice','David','Maria','Peter']
cs=[(lab,text,n) for lab,ss in patterns.items() for text in ss for n in names]; random.shuffle(cs)
items=[];control=[]
for label,text,n in cs:
 record=f'{n} says: "{text}"'
 items.append({'prompt':f'Classify the utterance as apology, thanks, or request.\n{record}\nAnswer:','answer':' '+label})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Who is speaking? Give the name only.\n{record}\nAnswer:','answer':' '+n})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
